application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round rechecked and retained proof hashes preserved.
Existing dimension monotonicity was found and not duplicated. Work instead establishes the mixed face step needed for Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz iteration.
The vertex product is partitioned exactly by first-coordinate membership, with all direction sums verified and no duplicated vertices.
The cross-correlation identity uses the actual Haar projection self-adjointness and idempotence already proved. No generic projection commutation assertion is assumed.
The resulting inequality is Cauchy-Schwarz on the finite product of root and remaining directions. It holds without unit bounds and includes d=0.
Five theorems are individually audited. The single face inequality is not claimed as a full iterated Gowers inequality, concatenation, Bessel, or proof of the principal target.
